BRAND PROJECT / 2025

Bean There

Coffee that feels like a familiar face.

Brand identity · Illustration
THE STORY

A world of
its own.

The idea

Bean There is a community-first coffee brand built around comfort, slow moments and warm conversations. The identity needed to feel welcoming before the first sip.

The design

An earthy palette, hand-drawn details and a friendly koala mascot create a visual world inspired by Japandi design. From the cup to the merchandise, each touchpoint invites people to slow down and stay a while.
